notes.title: Patch 0.108 is LIVE!
notes.notes: [p][b]It’s time for our next Early Access update to Elestrals Clash! and we’ve got a little bit of everything for you with this patch. We’ve got new cards, new cosmetics, bug fixes, and more.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Cards and Customization[/h3][p]Elestrals Clash! has added six new functional cards:[/p][list][*][p]Spinymph [i]Champion of Hermes[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Spinosect [i]Champion of Hermes[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fowlicane[/p][/*][*][p]Emphrostrix[/p][/*][*][p]Monsoon of Eurus[/p][/*][*][p]Pandora’s Box[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Frames and Effects:[/b] With this update, we’re adding nine new customizable frame options - one for each Spirit type and one for Omni! They’ll look like this: [/p][p][img src="https://cdn.cerealapis.com/page/484d5aee-dd46-4608-a7d2-e9d6bfbddd2a/upload-1756758593971.png"][/img]Choosing a custom frame will change both the full card and the on-board token. You can match your cards with their Spirits for a unified look… or you can fully embrace chaos and mix it up with Earth-framed Soarlet and Water-framed Necruff. (Water puppy!!)[/p][p]In addition, we have two new card VFX that will appear on play. When we saw this new lightning animation on Astrabbit, we were shocked! [/p][p][img src="https://cdn.cerealapis.com/page/33f3d597-aab2-4009-9736-ba72a6443937/upload-1756758625649.gif"][/img][img src="https://cdn.cerealapis.com/page/8455531d-f0dd-4636-94ee-5053a6a142b4/upload-1756758631629.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Pandora's Box[/h3][p][b]Our third Pandora’s Box is DEEP SEA RISING![/b] [b][img src="https://cdn.cerealapis.com/page/46d2a572-7b1c-41be-ae9b-af50f56c4052/upload-1756758724131.png"][/img][/b][/p][p]The new Box is awash with new items, including a new [b]FULL ART Stellar Galaxea[/b], a [b]Rise from the Depths Card Back[/b], and a statue of Poseidon himself. Most importantly, there’s a new Buddy… the fan favorite [b]STELLAR EDDY[/b] is back!!![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Clash Pass[/h3][p]Strike your enemies with the new Clash Pass, [b]PEAK OF OLYMPUS[/b]. ⚡ [img src="https://cdn.cerealapis.com/page/b377a0fa-6d66-40b4-8d6c-7005ce7c61ba/upload-1756758779094.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition to the free rewards refresh, the premium Clash Pass is a must-own for [b]Voltempest [i]Champion of Zeus[/i][/b] fans. Your favorite big bird is getting a new profile icon, a Full Art Stellar, and a Stellar Buddy! Earn these and more as you climb to the peak of Mount Olympus - and celebrate your ascent with an exclusive Game Board.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Elestrals were unable to Ascend in rare circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]Morphrost [i]Scorpio Form[/i]'s effect could activate against Elestrals who cannot be targeted. (Scorpio is still a bug. That’s normal.)[/p][/*][*][p]Hermes could target non-Elestral Wind cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio SFX continuously looped after an opponent conceded.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We have more exciting features and updates coming to Clash! in the near future. Stay tuned for more updates and continue sharing your feedback via the Elestrals Community Discord. Become a Member Today! [/p][p][url="https://Discord.gg/Elestrals"]Discord.gg/Elestrals[/url][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3277300/Elestrals_Clash/"][img src="https://cdn.cerealapis.com/page/3179d204-86ee-445b-b3fb-486031738e2b/upload-1756759077284.webp"][/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.107 is LIVE!
notes.notes: [p]Patch 0.107 is LIVE![/p][p]Thank for your participating in Early Access! We're continuing to address feedback and optimizing [i]Elestrals Clash![/i]. This update focuses on a refreshed Store experience, tutorial adjustments and correcting several gameplay interactions.[/p][p][b]Client Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new [b]Store[/b] section.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduces new 'Bear With Me' [b]Pandora's Box[/b] collection.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial[/b] improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed reconnect issues during [b]Tutorial[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Caster Profile now correctly starts at [b]Level 1[/b] instead of Level 0.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Engine Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Daily Task reroll sometimes leaving Casters with no tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]AI now properly responds to prompts.[/p][/*][*][p]When Thunderstorm is Cast, Titanostrike now correctly skips the Expend cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Shield of Achilles no longer affects targets Unaffected by Counter Runes.[/p][/*][*][p]Flarachne [i]Champion of Hestia[/i]'s end of turn effect is now triggered by its Caster.[/p][/*][*][p]Reforge now returns the correct number of Spirits based on the selected Artifact Rune.[/p][/*][*][p]Ankylosurge now discards cards correctly if the timer runs out.[/p][/*][*][p]Nemistar is now correctly affected by its own effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Lyre of Apollo's effect no longer persists if it, or its Empowered Elestral, is returned to hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Volcaries [i]Champion of Hephaestus[/i] can now use Fire Spirits from the Underworld even when the Spirit Deck has 0 Spirits.[/p][/*][*][p]Divine Runes no longer enchant the entire Spirit Deck when the timer runs out.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please continue to provide feedback within our [url="https://discord.gg/Elestrals"]Discord[/url]; we're always listening![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.106 is LIVE!
notes.notes: [p]This update focuses on tutorial improvements, new features, card fixes, and gameplay adjustments. Here’s what’s changed:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Client Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new [b]Mailbox[/b] feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to skip tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial no longer forces you into a ranked game.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked menu tutorial to support any resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Tornadjinn[/b] selection issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto pass settings will no longer allow the Caster to play two counter runes on the same chain if the last counter rune on the chain is owned by the Caster.[/p][/*][*][p]Chain Links now visually remove only when they are resolved instead of when they start resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Card Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new card: [b]Lycavoid[/b] (Moonrise).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Moustacean[/b] not showing in the available activation list if the Caster’s settings are set to Auto and the Caster's opponent Elestral has no effect when entering the field.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Engine Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issues with [b]Kryoling[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with [b]Resting on Your Laurels[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where cards (except for Instant Runes) were considered Cast once they started resolving their Chain Link. Now they are considered Cast when their Chain Link is removed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing! Please continue to provide issues you encounter via [url="https://discord.com/channels/1001588248084234370/1314251977949057107"]https://discord.com/channels/1001588248084234370/1314251977949057107[/url].[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.103 is live!
notes.notes: [p]This update focuses on fixing softlocks, visual bugs, and gameplay issues. Here's what’s changed:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Client Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Tutorial softlock when moving from [b]Necruff[/b] to [b]Blazerus[/b] on Nexus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Tutorial softlock when opening [b]Pandora’s Box[/b] store.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI remaining interactable when opponent concedes during [b]Mulligan[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Suppression indicator[/b] staying on screen after end of turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong [b]Argo[/b] card skin in [b]Clash Pass[/b] rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Vysceris[/b] card skin being swapped.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Bunnyx[/b] displaying incorrect subclasses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various [b]Caster Club[/b] account issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Engine Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed [b]Chrysoar – Champion of Aeolus[/b] being enchanted with too many [b]Spirits[/b] after Ascension.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Vysceris[/b] being unable to change positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Resting on Your Laurels[/b] not checking correctly on resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed double position swap issue with [b]Soarlet[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed softlock involving [b]Hestia’s Hearth[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and let us know if you spot anything else via our Discord [i]Elestrals Clash![/i] bug channel, [url="https://discord.com/channels/1001588248084234370/1314251977949057107"]https://discord.com/channels/1001588248084234370/1314251977949057107[/url][/p]
